correctness.rationale: Reconstructed admissible orbit-barycenter fixed geometry under st and the Klein four group: only four A singleton blocks, C first-pair and D second-pair two-orbits occur. All orbit compatibility inequalities follow from max Hamming distance ≤2. Four A blocks are simply connected since cube squares and two-step shortcuts fill. Coning the connected links of C and D identifies suffix rungs, so pi1 is a quotient of the square fundamental group Z. Suffix deletion is simplicial and splits F4 inclusion; explicit F4 collapse gives pi1(F4)=Z and forces exact pi1(Fn)=Z and H1=Z. Independently reconstructed F4 fixed-orbit graph and triangles: 8 vertices/16 edges/8 triangles; package script lists the 8 triangle-edge and 3 leaf pairs. The infinite proof is van Kampen plus retraction, not small-n extrapolation.
